name: Lian'ai Yinyouchi
source:
In 2021, arcade rhythm games began gaining popularity in small towns.
Liu Xizhe, who became obsessed with rhythm games only to have his tablet destroyed by his family, moved alone to a small town for school. There, he struggled to find classmates who shared his passion. He longed for companions—or even a partner—with similar interests...

Everything changed in 2022, during his second year of high school, when Liu Xizhe discovered an arcade rhythm game: [b]maimai DX[/b].
From then on, his life became intertwined with four rhythm game-obsessed girls, each with distinct personalities...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3792170]Steam[/url]]
translation:
2021年，街机节奏游戏开始在小镇流行。
迷恋节奏游戏却被家人毁掉平板电脑的刘熙哲，独自一人搬到小镇上学。在那里，他努力寻找志同道合的同学。他渴望有志同道合的同伴——甚至是伴侣……

一切都在2022年发生了变化，当时他高二，刘西哲发现了一款街机节奏游戏：[b]脉脉DX[/b]。
从此，他的生活与四个热爱节奏游戏、个性鲜明的女孩交织在一起……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3792170]Steam[/url]]
